name: Vintage Editorial
tagline: A cream magazine page with a Fraunces masthead, witty copy, circle-line-dot geometry and bold bordered call-to-action boxes. Adapted from the Vintage Editorial preset in frontend-slides.

palette.description: warm cream paper with near-black type, mid-grey secondary text and one warm sand accent used for highlighter strokes, filled circles and the recommended table column

typography.style: a soft, high-contrast display serif at 900/700 with italic 400 for deks, numerals and asides, paired with a quiet grotesque for body and wide-tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Decks with a voice: annual letters, newsletter and publication reviews, editorial or brand-story pitches, keynote talks and community updates. Strong for big statements, witty lists, before/after columns, three-number summaries and a clear call to action.
avoid_for: Hard-data dashboards, highly technical deep dives and very corporate or regulatory settings. The serif display and conversational copy expect personality.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
